_comment: The consent register a district would already hold, paired with examples/other-dialler-records.jsonl so tools/adopt_call_records.py has something real to audit those calls against. Fictional, and the guardian names are placeholders, because a real register holds names and this repository publishes none. Chosen so three of the six calls come back as findings and each finding is a different reason: CR-2004 was withdrawn before the call, CR-2006 names a number the call did not use, and S-2005 rests on no record at all. The other three are covered and print as covered, because a gate that only ever finds fault is one nobody believes. The schema is docs/consent-record.md and dispatch/consent.py enforces it.

records.evidence: enrolment pack 2026-27, section 4, signed; withdrawn by telephone
